source: Project-specific original generations from written prompts. No external reference image was supplied. Original PNGs are distributed in Assets/Moonlit/Resources.

images.prompt: Wide 16:9 full-bleed illustrated background for an indie Vietnamese folk-tale pixel-art game title screen, no UI and absolutely no lettering, typography, symbols-as-text, borders or logos. Crisp painstakingly clustered retro pixel art with limited color palette, pixel silhouette clarity, flat stepped color ramps, subtle woodcut folk print pattern on a few surfaces. Beautiful cinematic moonlit North Vietnamese village, indigo blue, dark teal, glowing amber. Composition is crucial: LEFT 42 percent of frame is very dark low-contrast open sky and deep shadow foliage suitable for a typography overlay, while the story vignette is on the RIGHT 58 percent. A childlike young Vietnamese woodcutter Cuoi dressed in brown village tunic and dark blue headwrap, barefoot, seen in three-quarter profile standing amid grass on the right foreground (at 72 percent width), lifts a real five-point red-and-amber paper star lantern on a bamboo handle near his shoulder, lighting his face. Distant tiled đình temple and thatched cottages, misty terraced paddies, bamboo, a few warm fireflies, reflections on the village stream. Upper right-mid sky features four clearly disconnected chunks of a luminous golden moon, with visible gaps of indigo, not four moons. Atmospheric depth, memorable lantern glow, bold legible silhouettes. Keep content inside safe crop for 16:9. Dark foreground to edges, stylish authentic hand-crafted game key art. No text anywhere.

images.purpose: Ending after the banyan is calmed
images.prompt: Cinematic widescreen 16:9 final cutscene illustration for an original Vietnamese folk tale pixel art game. No text, no user interface, no logos, no frame. A joyful but quiet moonlit homecoming. A HUGE INTACT ROUND pale golden full moon in the midnight sky on the RIGHT at 70% width. In front of it on the RIGHT HALF of the picture, the magical old banyan tree and its entire little piece of earth are lifting into the air on long floating roots. A small barefoot Vietnamese woodcutter Cuoi in a brown tunic and indigo headscarf sits on a big curved branch, dangling his legs, holding a glowing red five-point Vietnamese paper star lantern on a stick. Deep night blue giant sky, golden rim lighting and warm peaceful atmosphere, tiny faraway village and rice paddies far below, soft cloud bands, emberlike fireflies among the aerial roots. Storybook fairytale ending. A true retro 16-bit high-quality pixel art scene with confident stepped palette ramps, clusters of hand-placed pixels, limited dark indigo/jade/amber palette evocative of traditional woodblock prints. LEFTMOST 43% contains mostly dark quiet night sky and haze to allow a game ending title and buttons to be overlaid, focal point on right, good contrast. Keep important details within 16:9 safe area. No typography, no lettering, no watermarks.
